findings.title: Qualify owned-context observation as native-only
findings.evidence: open() sets blocking_validation to !cfg!(target_arch = "wasm32"); therefore owned browser contexts disable observation, whereas this added sentence says all owned contexts enable it. The guide already describes browser behavior correctly.
findings.correction: Say “Owned native contexts enable this observation. Borrowed contexts and browser targets disable it …”, preserving the separate provider-policy distinction.
